mainline/wawasi#1.zh: 离了桃花村，众人取路往延安府。行了半日，鲁智深肚里饥饿，远远望见一座古寺，便同%N先去化些斋饭；史进、陈达往林子里寻些吃食，朱武、杨春看守行李。
mainline/wawasi#1.t: Leaving Peach Blossom Village, the group took the road to Yan'an. After half a day, Lu Zhishen was starving. Seeing an old temple in the distance, he went ahead with %N to beg a meal; Shi Jin and Chen Da searched the woods for food, while Zhu Wu and Yang Chun watched the baggage.

mainline/wawasi#2.zh: 好大一座寺，怎地这般败落？山门也倒了，佛殿上都是蛛网。
mainline/wawasi#2.t: Such a big temple, so run-down? The gate's collapsed and the main hall is all cobwebs.

mainline/wawasi#3.zh: 廊下坐着几个老和尚，面黄肌瘦。问时，说寺里来了一个和尚、一个道人，把常住的东西都卖了，赶走了众僧，只剩他们几个老的走不动，已饿了三日。
mainline/wawasi#3.t: Some old monks sat in the corridor, sallow and gaunt. They said a monk and a Taoist had come, sold off the temple's property and driven out the brothers. Only these few, too old to walk, were left, and they hadn't eaten in three days.

mainline/wawasi#4.zh: 鲁兄，那殿前吃酒的两个，想必就是了。
mainline/wawasi#4.t: Brother Lu, those two drinking in front of the hall must be the ones.

mainline/wawasi#5.zh: 你这两个，如何把寺来废了！
mainline/wawasi#5.t: You two! How dare you ruin this temple!

mainline/wawasi#6.t: Please sit, brother, and hear me out...

mainline/wawasi#7.t: Hear what, damn you! Take my staff!

mainline/wawasi#8.zh: 哥哥，这秃驴吃饱了撑的来管闲事，一发结果了他！
mainline/wawasi#8.t: Brother, this bald donkey has nothing better to do than meddle. Let's finish him!

mainline/wawasi#9.zh: 小乙，你先打发了这秃驴，洒家吃完这碗酒再来。
mainline/wawasi#9.t: Xiaoyi, deal with this bald donkey first. I'll come once I finish this bowl.

mainline/wawasi#10.zh: 智深一路未曾吃饭，又走了许多路，气力不加。
mainline/wawasi#10.t: Zhishen hadn't eaten all the way and had walked far. His strength was failing.

mainline/wawasi#12.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打倒崔道成

mainline/wawasi#14.zh: 失败条件二 --- 鲁智深死亡

mainline/wawasi#16.zh: 鲁大哥！林子里买了些干肉烧饼，先吃了再打！
mainline/wawasi#16.t: Brother Lu! We bought dried meat and flatbread in the woods. Eat first, then fight!

mainline/wawasi#17.zh: 这两个鸟人，便是霸占寺院的？交给俺！
mainline/wawasi#17.t: So these two are the ones who seized the temple? Leave them to me!

mainline/wawasi#18.zh: 来得好！洒家肚饥，正斗他两个不过！……好饼！这回看洒家的！
mainline/wawasi#18.t: Just in time! I was too hungry to beat the pair of them! ...Good bread! Now watch me!

mainline/wawasi#19.zh: 崔道成提着朴刀，引着几个强人从殿后杀出来！
mainline/wawasi#19.t: Cui Daocheng charges out from behind the hall with a broadsword and some bandits!

mainline/wawasi#20.zh: 小的们，都出来！莫教这秃驴走了！
mainline/wawasi#20.t: Lads, come out! Don't let this bald donkey get away!

mainline/wawasi#21.zh: 吃饱了正好！生铁佛，洒家等你多时了！
mainline/wawasi#21.t: Perfect, I'm full now! Iron Buddha, I've been waiting for you!

mainline/wawasi#22.zh: 飞天夜叉丘小乙倒在殿前，再也飞不起来了。
mainline/wawasi#22.t: Flying Yaksha Qiu Xiaoyi falls in front of the hall, never to fly again.

mainline/wawasi#23.zh: 生铁佛？这回教你做个烂铁佛！
mainline/wawasi#23.t: Iron Buddha? This time you'll be a scrap-iron Buddha!

mainline/wawasi#24.zh: 剩下的强人见崔道成倒了，发一声喊，四散逃走。
mainline/wawasi#24.t: Seeing Cui Daocheng fall, the remaining bandits gave a shout and scattered.

mainline/wawasi#25.zh: 众人寻到寺后，搜出崔道成藏下的米粮、金银。智深把米粮分与那几个老和尚，叫他们自寻生路去。
mainline/wawasi#25.t: Behind the temple they found the grain, gold and silver Cui Daocheng had hidden. Zhishen gave the grain to the old monks and told them to go make their own way.

mainline/wawasi#26.zh: 鲁大哥，这寺留着，日后又招强人来住。
mainline/wawasi#26.t: Brother Lu, if we leave this temple standing, more bandits will move in later.

mainline/wawasi#28.zh: 当夜一把火，烧了瓦罐寺。众人望着火光，取路往延安府去了。
mainline/wawasi#28.t: That night they set fire to Wagang Temple. Watching the blaze, the group took the road to Yan'an.

mainline/wawasi#29.zh: 洒家这一把火，教这伙鸟人再占不得佛门！
mainline/wawasi#29.t: With this fire of mine, those scum will never hold a house of the Buddha again!

mainline/wawasi#31.zh: %N死于乱刀之下，鲁智深饿得手脚无力，也被崔道成、丘小乙所害，瓦罐寺从此成了强人的窝……
mainline/wawasi#31.t: %N fell under a flurry of blades. Lu Zhishen, weak with hunger, was killed by Cui Daocheng and Qiu Xiaoyi too, and Wagang Temple became a bandits' den...

mainline/wawasi#32.zh: 鲁智深饿着肚子力战不支，倒在佛殿前。众人无心再往延安府，各自散去……
mainline/wawasi#32.t: Fighting on an empty stomach, Lu Zhishen could hold out no longer and fell before the hall. With no heart left to go on to Yan'an, the group went their separate ways...
